randomization.arm_order_reason: The metric is cold-process simulated instructions, with within-configuration A/A. Budget-dependent completion and order are disclosed; no native-time inference.

seed_derivation.note: Uniform: SplitMix64 seed 202610260001 xor p xor (b<<16) xor shift. Existing target: 202610210000+label+p*65537, first nonzero source lift.

instance_sampling.rule: All ten original odd-prime-order toy fixtures; no measured-outcome filtering.

blinding.how: After deterministic finite/receipt verification, withhold labelled audit/raw data from the analyst. Native blind maps methods/workloads under a private random key, recomputes primary ratios from masked Ir cells, and writes a key hash. Inspect MASKED_ANALYSIS before unmask; unmask replays masked results and checks all distributions equal. Numerical signatures may still suggest labels; no independent analyst/host.
